verdict.rationale: Evidence shows Xero offers an MCP *server* so external AI agents (like Claude or custom bots) can call Xero's own tools — the opposite direction from the story, which asks whether a user can plug external MCP servers into Xero so Xero's own AI (e.g., JAX) can use their tools. No evidence indicates Xero can act as an MCP client/host consuming third-party MCP servers.
